game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats, flats of tall cacti: the sand ranger must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats: flats of tall cacti
core_gameplay_loop: In Cactus Flats, repeat each round: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order. Each round, dust devils strike the bazaar gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the program_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the bazaar gate from dust devils in Cactus Flats: keep the program_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: program_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Program Assembler
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cactus Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how program_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Cactus Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while program_ok > 0.
